name: Series 140 three-piece ball valve
summary: A full-port, three-piece ball valve that can be serviced in line without cutting the pipe.
body:
The Series 140 is the valve most of our customers know us for. The center section swings out after removing two body bolts, so seats and seals can be replaced without disturbing the piping.

Each valve is pressure-tested at 1.5 times rated pressure at the Brask Ford plant, and the test record is tied to the serial number on the tag.
ends: NPT, socket weld, butt weld, tri-clamp
specs: Bore :: Full port||Seats :: RPTFE, PEEK option||Stem :: Blowout-proof, live-loaded||Mounting pad :: ISO 5211 F03–F07||Fire tested :: API 607 option
pn: B140 :: Series||-S :: Stainless body (C for carbon)||-20 :: Size code, 20 = 2 in||-SW :: Socket weld ends||-P :: PEEK seats

name: Series 160 sanitary ball valve
summary: A cavity-filled ball valve for food, beverage and pharmaceutical lines, with 20 Ra internal finish.
body:
The Series 160 is machined from 316L bar stock and electropolished. Cavity fillers keep product out of the dead space behind the ball, so the valve can be cleaned in place.

Every valve ships with a material test report and a surface-finish record.

pn: B160 :: Series||-15 :: Size code, 15 = 1.5 in||-TC :: Tri-clamp ends||-EP :: Electropolished

name: Series 210 lug butterfly valve
summary: A resilient-seated lug butterfly valve for water, HVAC and general service up to 24 inches.
body: The Series 210 uses a one-piece shaft and a bonded EPDM liner. It installs between ANSI 150 flanges and is rated for dead-end service with the downstream flange removed.
materials: Ductile iron body; 316 SS or aluminum-bronze disc

name: Series 260 high-performance butterfly valve
summary: A double-offset butterfly valve for steam, hydrocarbons and higher pressures.
body: The double-offset disc lifts off the seat in the first few degrees of travel, so the seat wears less and torque stays low. A fire-safe metal backup seat is available.
certs: ISO 9001|API 609 Category B|API 607 fire safe option

name: Series 310 dual-plate check valve
summary: A short, light dual-plate check valve that closes before flow reverses.
body: Two spring-loaded plates close quickly as flow slows, which limits water hammer on pump discharge lines. The wafer body is a fraction of the weight of a swing check.
specs: Closure :: Spring assisted, non-slam||Seat :: Metal or EPDM||Orientation :: Horizontal or vertical up

name: Series 420 globe control valve
summary: A cage-guided globe valve for flow, pressure and level control.
body: The Series 420 uses quick-change trim: the cage, plug and seat ring come out from the top without removing the body from the line. Equal-percentage, linear and anti-cavitation trims share the same body.

name: Series 450 sanitary diaphragm valve
summary: A weir diaphragm valve for sterile process lines, with a drainable body.
body: Product only touches the forged body and the diaphragm. Bodies are marked with the angle that makes them self-draining in horizontal lines.

summary: A double-acting or spring-return pneumatic actuator in eleven sizes.
body: The PRA-50 bolts directly to any valve with an ISO 5211 top flange. Hard-anodized bodies and stainless fasteners suit washdown areas.

name: ERA-20 electric quarter-turn actuator
summary: A compact electric actuator with a manual override and position feedback.
body: The ERA-20 runs on 24 V or 120 V and reports position over 4–20 mA. Its manual override works without power, and the dome indicator is visible from 30 feet.

name: Series 510 ANSI process pump
summary: A back-pull-out end-suction pump to ANSI B73.1 dimensions.
body: The bearing frame and impeller come out toward the motor, so the casing and piping stay in place for service. Each pump is run on the test loop at Linnmoor before it ships, and its curve is archived under its serial number.

summary: A space-saving inline pump for HVAC and building services.
body: The Series 540 mounts directly in the pipe, which saves floor space in mechanical rooms. Split couplings let the seal be changed without removing the motor.

name: Series 580 air-operated double diaphragm pump
summary: A seal-less AODD pump for slurries, solvents and shear-sensitive fluids.
body: No electricity at the pump, no seals to leak, and it can run dry. The air valve is lubrication-free and stall-free.
